notes.title: Update Notes for Apr 3 - Much More to Find
notes.notes:
Several new things have been added, and thank you to the wonderful community members who found some spelling errors and corrections that needed to be made!


 Help menu has been updated.
 Admin mode was added.
 Andrew Parker's clearance level was updated for accuracy.

notes.title: First update, new features!
notes.notes:

 New logins were added appropriately.
